name: Sentinel Standard Care Package
summary: The Sentinel Standard Care Package is an Alliance requisition offered to warriors proving their worth in Warsong Gulch. Distributed by Illiyana Moonblaze in Ashenvale, it equips dedicated defenders of the Silverwing Sentinels with essential combat supplies tailored specifically for the contested valley.

sections.title: Supplying the Front Lines
sections.body: The ongoing struggle against the Warsong Outriders in Ashenvale demands constant logistical support. To sustain Alliance champions fighting among the ancient trees of Warsong Gulch, the Silverwing Sentinels distribute prepared bundles of battle rations and field bandages. These care packages ensure that frontline skirmishers remain nourished and mended during fierce engagements to protect the sacred forest.

sections.title: Earning Silverwing Trust
sections.body: Illiyana Moonblaze oversees these allotments from the Silverwing grove. While initial recruits receive modest basic supplies, continued service and rising standing among the night elves unlock standard care packages. As a soldier becomes an established presence on the battlefield, the Sentinels open their regular quartermaster stores, allowing dependable fighters direct access to provisions and medical supplies for the war effort.

faq.q: Who offers the Sentinel Standard Care Package?
faq.answer: The package is provided by Illiyana Moonblaze, the supply officer for the Silverwing Sentinels stationed near the entrance to Warsong Gulch in Ashenvale.

faq.q: What is inside the care package?
aliases: what is in standard care package
faq.answer: The care package contains battlefield rations and restorative bandages tailored specifically for use while fighting within Warsong Gulch.

faq.q: Can the items from this package be used anywhere?
aliases: where to use care package items
faq.answer: No. The specialized rations and bandages enclosed within the package are strictly designated for combat engagements inside Warsong Gulch.

faq.q: What is required to earn this care package?
aliases: how to get standard care package
faq.answer: You must prove yourself in battle alongside the Silverwing Sentinels in Warsong Gulch and earn their ongoing trust, following the completion of your initial basic supply requisitions.

faq.q: Why are the Silverwing Sentinels fighting here?
faq.answer: The Silverwing Sentinels are defending Ashenvale's ancient forests from the Warsong clan of orcs, who have established logging operations and deep outposts throughout the sacred woodland.

faq.q: What comes after the Standard Care Package?
aliases: next quest after standard care package
faq.answer: Continued distinction in the battleground leads to higher recognition from the Sentinels, eventually qualifying dedicated Alliance soldiers for the Sentinel Advanced Care Package.

angles.text: The Silverwing Sentinels rely on Alliance champions of all races to blunt the Horde's expansion into Ashenvale, rewarding loyal fighters with dedicated battleground provisions.
For night elves, defending Ashenvale from the Warsong Outriders is a sacred duty to preserve their ancestral homeland from desecration.
